description.en: An umbrella social-assistance programme for eligible below-poverty-line households, covering central old-age, widow, and disability pensions, a family benefit after the death of a primary breadwinner, and Annapurna food support.

benefit_summary.en: The central component and eligibility differ by sub-scheme. States and Union Territories may add assistance or apply their implementation process, so the payable amount and application channel must be checked locally.

eligibility_summary.en: The central guidelines apply the components to below-poverty-line persons or households and then use sub-scheme conditions such as age, widowhood, severe disability, or death of the primary breadwinner. State verification decides final inclusion.

instruction.en: Identify whether the need is old-age pension, widow pension, disability pension, family benefit, or food support.
Contact the Gram Panchayat, local body, block office, or state social-assistance portal for the current application and state top-up rules.
Submit the sub-scheme documents requested by the state and keep the acknowledgement for status tracking.
